text:
Ivy: Quick check 449 who wants to do hill repeats at 5:45pm? 6 x 90s efforts, walk-down recovery. Great for power. :mountain: 
Marcus: I'm down but can only make the first 3. Also thinking of a short hangboard intro at 6:30 for anyone staying after 4AA low volume, technique only.
Talia: Can the hangboard be scaled for fingers in rehab? My physio gave me a green band to protect my pulley. :pleading_face:
Ben: Absolutely. Hangboard plan will include no-max hangs progressions and plenty of rest. We can use assisted holds.
Ivy: Plan: meet at the alley stairs 17:45, 18:30 meet at wall for hangboard demo in training room.
Marcus: Small suggested hangboard protocol: ```Hangboard 20-min intro
- Warmup 8-10 min (easy fingertip hangs on jug + mobility)
- 5 sets: 7s hang / 53s rest (use assisted holds)
- 3 sets: 5s slow negative / 25s rest
- Cooldown finger mobility 5 min```
Talia: Thanks 60A that looks doable. I'll bring a small towel + tape.
RunBot: Reminder set - Hill repeats @17:45 meet by alley stairs (automated) :bell:
Ivy: If anyone needs a headlamp for the walk home after, I have one spare. Also we can grab a post-session chai at the cafe if people are around. :tea:
Ben: Safety note - bring a light ankle brace if you have prior sprains, stairs are slick if wet.
Marcus: I'll scout the stairs route at 17:30 and post a pic of the best line.
Talia: RSVP: in for both. Might bail on last two repeats if my knee nags.
Ivy: Great. I'll post a short sign-up for who wants hangboard spots (limit 6) so we can rotate.
Ben: See y'all tonight. :thumbsup:
